decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Statement, Unnumbered Location Plan, Unnumbered Block Plan, 01, 02, 01-1, 02-1, BS5837 Arboricultural Report &Tree Constraints Plan (dated: 18/08/2016), Heritage Statement - Illustrations, Heritage Statement, Unnumbered Tree Location Plan, Received: 10/03/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the boundary treatment of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Replacement of the existing close-board fence that currently runs around the perimeter of the site as well as the replacement of the non-original pedestrian gate and vehicle gates within the front elevation of the property.
